chunks: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abā 'Abdillāh عليه السلام about a man who becomes junub in a garment, or urine comes upon it, and he has no garment other than it. He said: "He prays in it if he is compelled to use it."

key_terms.الثَّوْبِ: the garment or clothing in question
key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: to enter the state of janabah

ai.seo_question: Can a person pray in a garment soiled by janabah or urine if no other clothing is available?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat in a garment affected by janabah or urine when no other garment is available. It indicates that in a state of necessity, one may pray in that garment, showing the consideration of hardship in ritual law.
